title: Tahoe Coastal Self-Guided E-Bike Tour(2–4 hrs) | East Shore Trail
includes: Thorough and knowledgeable Orientation on all the attractions to experience during the ride
Bike Racks with Bungie for added storage
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Minimum Age is 12+. Riders under Age 18 must be accompanied by a Parent
E-Bikes are Heavier! So riders must be comfortable riding a traditional bike
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our amazing team is bursting with excitement to show you all the incredible sights and sounds along your Lake Tahoe journey! Picture this: we’ll whisk you away from stunning Incline Village, cruising past jaw-dropping mansions on Billionaire’s Row! Then, hold onto your hats, because we’re hitting the legendary Lake Tahoe East Shore Trail, leading us straight to the breathtaking Sand Harbor State Park! Get ready to dive into a world of delicious food, sun-kissed beaches, magical walking trails, and endless water adventures! This isn’t just a trip, it’s a THRILL RIDE of pure, unadulterated FUN!

Insider Scoop: Looking for a shorter adventure? Opt for our two-hour rental to experience the entire trail while saving money—perfect for a quick, scenic spin! Experience the stunning East Shore Trail at your own pace while beating the heat and crowds with our convenient early morning start times. 

- Min Age is 12+. Riders under Age 18 must be accompanied by a Parent
